## Description

1. User identifies their location and business need. 2. User finds the local SBDC by ZIP/county/service area. 3. New user completes the SBDC intake/registration process.

## When to use this document

Questions about business planning, ecosystem navigation, government contracting, international trade, legal and compliance, market research. Business stages: Validation. # SBDC Government Procurement and UH APEX Resource Selection Process

## Description

1. If the user is only thinking about starting a business, keep SBDC primary and focus on validation, operations, and readiness. 2. If the user is newly selling but has little track record, use Government Jumpstation to educate them by stage. 3. If the user is an existing for-profit business with a legally formed entity, products/services it can actually sell, and relevant experience/capacity, consider UH APEX Accelerator.

## When to use this document

Questions about formation, government contracting, legal and compliance, market research, operations. Business stages: Validation, Formation, Operations. Organizations covered: Small Business Development Center (SBDC), APEX Accelerator, University of Houston.

## Key information

- If the user is only thinking about starting a business, keep SBDC primary and focus on validation, operations, and readiness.
- If the user is newly selling but has little track record, use Government Jumpstation to educate them by stage.
- If the user is an existing for-profit business with a legally formed entity, products/services it can actually sell, and relevant experience/capacity, consider UH APEX Accelerator.

## Relevant links and contacts

- Organizations: Small Business Development Center (SBDC), APEX Accelerator, University of Houston

# SBDC 77084 Service Area Note: Houston, Fort Bend, Southwest Harris

## Description

Houston-area ZIP codes can sit near county and service-area boundaries. The SBA ZIP search for 77084 returned Harris County resources, and the UH SBDC locations catalog identifies multiple Harris-area service areas. - Resources include the SBA 77084 SBDC locator result as the first official source. - Consider Houston Center SBDC for Central/North Harris resource matching.

## When to use this document

Questions about legal and compliance. Organizations covered: U.S. Small Business Administration (SBA), Small Business Development Center (SBDC), University of Houston.

## Key information

- Houston-area ZIP codes can sit near county and service-area boundaries. The SBA ZIP search for 77084 returned Harris County resources, and the UH SBDC locations catalog identifies multiple Harris-area service areas.
- Resources include the SBA 77084 SBDC locator result as the first official source.
- Consider Houston Center SBDC for Central/North Harris resource matching.
- Consider Fort Bend County SBDC when the user is in Southwest Harris or near Fort Bend/Katy-area boundaries.
- Consider Prairie View A&M SBDC if the user is in Waller County.
- Consider Lee College or San Jacinto College SBDCs for East Harris-related resource matching.

## Relevant links and contacts

- Organizations: U.S. Small Business Administration (SBA), Small Business Development Center (SBDC), University of Houston
